newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London rise in sleepy trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London rise in sleepy trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London rose in sleepy trading on Wednesday on the back of firmer performances by Wall Street and the FTSE 100, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index rose 42.37 points to 12,808.39 by 1536 GMT. The Hang Seng closed down 49.35 points at 12,766.02.
Both Wall Street and the London FTSE 100 index were up roughly 30 points in afternoon trading.
"The Hong Kong stocks are better on the back of the UK market and helped by a firmer Wall Street," said one trader.

Another trader said the slightly firmer trend in London was simply a reaction to the "bit of nervousness in the morning in Hong Kong" after the stronger then expected U.S. housing starts figures released on Tuesday.
